text:
maya: Heads up — Kibana searches for correlation IDs in eu-west are returning incomplete results since ~09:12 UTC. Multiple SLO dashboards show gaps. Anyone seen related sampling/config churn?

devon: saw the grafana alert at 09:14 — log_search_error_rate_high. I started a query, timing out at 30s.

monitoring-bot: ALERT: log_search_error_rate_high fired (group: central-logs) — 1.4% error rate over 5m.

maya: sample query I ran (very slow):
```
GET /_search
{ "query": { "match": { "trace.id": "abc123" } }, "size": 1000 }
```

samir: quick note: Loki sampling config was rolled last night to reduce high-cardinality streams. configmap shows sampling.rate: 0.1 in eu-west1, was 1.0 before. Could explain missing prefixes in central index.

leah: that would explain missing trace prefixes — many low-frequency trace IDs are getting dropped at ingest. What was the rollout annotation?

devon: rollout annotation on configmap: `gitops/loki-sampling@2026-03-16-23:05` — ops change to cut cost, applied via kustomize.

maya: ouch — cost-saving change without coordination. Can we temporarily bump sampling back for a narrow time window for troubleshooting?

samir: yes. I can patch the configmap to set sampling.rate: 0.5 for 15m on a subset of tenants. Patch command: 
```
kubectl -n observability patch configmap loki-sampling --patch '{"data":{"sampling.rate":"0.5"}}'
```

devon: alternative: run a targeted re-query against the raw hot-store (read replica) to avoid sampling layer. Query example for loki: 
```
{job="ingester"} |= "trace.id=abc123"
```

leah: also seeing increased query bursts from support trying to hunt missing errors — that's driving query cost up. If we flip sampling globally it might reduce retries but spike ingest cost — need approval.

maya: TL;DR ask: revert sampling to 1.0 for eu-west debug window or patch 0.5 for specific tenant = lower noise. Which is faster?

samir: patching to 0.5 scoped to tenant-label selector is fastest. Reverting to 1.0 requires a full rollout and may cause a short spike in S3 PUTs.

monitoring-bot: Event logged: incident-temp-replay created by samir at 09:21.

devon: once patched, run the correlation query with `size: 5000` and use `timeout: 120s` in Kibana dev tools. Also set `preference=_shards:0`? (kidding, don't do that) :grimace:

maya: I'll coordinate with support to pause wide re-queries. Samir — please patch and report back with before/after counts for `trace.id` hits.

samir: on it. patch applied at 09:25, sampling.rate=0.5 for tenant=prod-eu.

devon: re-run shows trace hits increased from 3 -> 42 for `abc123` (09:30). SLO dashboards backfilled partially. Looks promising.

leah: can we add an alert to warn when sampling.rate config flips (gitops annotation change)? That would prevent silent rollouts.

maya: yes, add a prometheus rule watching configmap revision/gitsync events. Also add an advisory to the playbook: "do not lower sampling without eng-sre sign-off for 24h".

samir: created PR for config-change alert and playbook update: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/PR/457.

maya: thanks. We'll keep the 0.5 patch for 30m and monitor costs. If costs spike we can revert to 0.1 but that hurts visibility.

monitoring-bot: RESOLVED: log_search_error_rate_high at 09:41 — error rate down to 0.2%.

maya: great work everyone. Follow-up items: lock sampling changes behind a flag, add rollout-approval step in gitops, and add a dashboard showing sampling.rate per-region.

devon: noted — I'll add the dashboard panel and pull request for the alert rule.

leah: also recommend a lightweight runbook snippet: how to reroute heavy ad-hoc queries to read-replica via header `X-Prefer-Replica: true`.

maya: archived notes in incident-temp-replay thread. Closing this thread shortly. :white_check_mark:
